Please solve this issue: We are building Quizzy, a live quiz app for conference talks, as a Ruby on Rails application. Start in the `/app` Git repository. It has no app yet. Ruby 3.4.4, Rails 8.1.4, the gems of a default `rails new` app, SQLite, and Chromium are installed. You can install other gems from rubygems.org; other network access is blocked. Install all dependencies while you work: we verify the app without network access.

Feel free to store any design notes/insights that could be useful for future steps in the docs/ folder.

How we run the app:

- We start it with `bin/serve` from the project root and these environment variables: `RAILS_ENV=production`, `PORT=3000`, `SECRET_KEY_BASE`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME`, `QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD`.
- `bin/serve` prepares everything the app needs (the database, assets, and so on) and runs the app in production mode in the foreground. It listens on all interfaces on `PORT`.
- The app is served over plain HTTP (no SSL, no HTTPS redirects) and accepts any host name.
- `GET /up` responds with `200` when the app is ready.
- The app keeps all its data under `storage/`. It must not call external services.

Our QA auto-tests drive the app in a browser and rely on the labels in quotes in each task. Keep them exactly as written, as visible text, a <label>, a placeholder, or an aria-label.

The QA auto-tests also expect:

- Each item of a list (a quiz, a question) sits in its own list item or table row, with its buttons and links inside it.
- Switches are checkboxes (a styled switch is fine if a real checkbox sits under it).
- Confirmations use the browser's native `confirm()` dialog.

Moderators started asking for this:

> As a moderator, I want to reuse my quiz at another conference, or share it with a colleague who runs Quizzy too.

The quiz page gets the "Export" link. It opens a page that shows the quiz as JSON inside a `<pre>` element (the only `<pre>` on the page), ready to copy.

`/moderate` gets the "Import quiz" button. It opens a page with a "Quiz JSON" text area and the "Import" button. Importing always creates a new quiz, even if a quiz with the same title exists, and opens its page.

The format:

```json
{
  "title": "Frontend Fest 2026",
  "questions": [
    {
      "text": "Which HTTP status code means \"Too Many Requests\"?",
      "active": true,
      "options": [
        {"text": "418", "correct": false},
        {"text": "429", "correct": true}
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

- `questions` and `options` keep their order.
- On import, `active` is optional (`true` by default), and `correct` is optional (`false` by default).
- The export always writes both, and it writes exactly these keys: the quiz title and its questions, nothing else. The export is only for moving quiz contents.
- Imported questions follow the same rules as the question form.

When the JSON is invalid or breaks a rule, the page shows an error and nothing is imported: not the quiz, not a part of its questions.

## Overview

Quizzy is a Rails 8.1 application using SQLite (`storage/`), Propshaft, Importmap, Turbo, Stimulus, and Solid Cable / Solid Cache / Solid Queue (all configured to store data exclusively under `storage/` with zero external service calls).

## Boot & Production Serving (`bin/serve`)

- `bin/serve` sets `RAILS_ENV=production` and `PORT` (default `3000`), precompiles assets (`bin/rails assets:precompile`), prepares SQLite databases (`bin/rails db:prepare`), and runs Puma in the foreground bound to `0.0.0.0:$PORT`.
- Plain HTTP is used (`config.assume_ssl = false`, `config.force_ssl = false`) and all hostnames are accepted (`config.hosts.clear`).
- `GET /up` serves the public health check (`200 OK`).
- Every route under `/moderate` inherits from `Moderate::BaseController`, which enforces HTTP Basic Authentication against `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME"]` and `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD"]`.

## Data Model (Release 1: Preparing Quizzes)

- `Quiz` (`quizzes`): `title` (required, whitespace-normalized). Has many `questions` ordered by `(position, id)` and `active_questions` (`where(active: true)`).
- `Question` (`questions`): belongs to `quiz`; `body` (required), `active` (boolean, default `true`), `position` (integer). Has many `options` ordered by `(position, id)`.
  - `Question#save_with_option_rows` skips blank option rows, validates at least 2 non-empty options (`"Add at least two options"`) and at least 1 correct non-empty option (`"Mark at least one option as correct"`), and atomically replaces options in a transaction while preserving submitted rows in-memory on validation failure.
  - `move_up!` / `move_down!` swap `position` with the adjacent question in a transaction.
- `Option` (`options`): belongs to `question`; `body` (required), `correct` (boolean, default `false`), `position` (integer).

## Frontend & Design System (`quizzy.css`)

- `app/assets/stylesheets/quizzy.css` and `app/assets/fonts/Inter-latin.woff2` come directly from `docs/mockups/`.
- Note for future releases: `quizzy.css` already includes pre-built styles for upcoming features:
  - **Big-screen presentation**: `.cover`, `.cover--blue`, `.cover--night`, `.screen`, `.screen-controls`, `.lobby`, `.qr`, `.counter-pill`, `.stage-question__*`, `.stage-options`, `.stage-option.is-correct`, `.leaderboard`, `.leader.is-winner`.
  - **Mobile participant play**: `.play`, `.join-form`, `.waiting`, `.waiting__gem`, `.play-options`, `.play-option`, `.play-status--right`, `.play-status--wrong`, `.result-card`, `.winner-banner`.
  - **Moderator responses**: `.tabs`, `.tab`, `.mark`, `.response-options`, `.response-option`, `.runs-table`, `.badge--running`, `.badge--finished`.
- Stimulus controllers:
  - `option-rows` (`app/javascript/controllers/option_rows_controller.js`): dynamically adds/removes and renumbers option rows (`Option N` / `Option N is correct`) on the question form.
  - `active-toggle` (`app/javascript/controllers/active_toggle_controller.js`): immediately persists `Active` checkbox changes via `fetch(..., { keepalive: true })` and updates active counts/numbering in-place.
- Moderator Preview (`Moderate::PreviewsController#show`): stateless `GET`-driven flow through `quiz.active_questions` in order without writing any database or session state.

class Question < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :quiz
  has_many :options, -> { order(:position, :id) }, dependent: :destroy

  validates :body, presence: true

  def move_up!
    Question.transaction do
      prev_q = quiz.questions.where("position < ? OR (position = ? AND id < ?)", position, position, id)
                             .reorder(position: :desc, id: :desc)
                             .first
      return unless prev_q

      swap_positions!(prev_q)
    end
  end

  def move_down!
    Question.transaction do
      next_q = quiz.questions.where("position > ? OR (position = ? AND id > ?)", position, position, id)
                             .reorder(position: :asc, id: :asc)
                             .first
      return unless next_q

      swap_positions!(next_q)
    end
  end

  def save_with_option_rows(body:, active:, option_rows:)
    errors.clear
    self.body = body.to_s
    self.active = active.nil? ? self.active : (ActiveModel::Type::Boolean.new.cast(active) == true)

    cleaned_body = self.body.strip
    errors.add(:base, "Question can't be blank") if cleaned_body.empty?

    non_empty_rows = option_rows.filter_map do |row|
      text = row[:body].to_s.strip
      next if text.empty?

      { body: text, correct: ActiveModel::Type::Boolean.new.cast(row[:correct]) == true }
    end

    if non_empty_rows.size < 2
      errors.add(:base, "Add at least two options")
    elsif non_empty_rows.none? { |r| r[:correct] }
      errors.add(:base, "Mark at least one option as correct")
    end

    return false if errors.any?

    Question.transaction do
      self.body = cleaned_body
      if new_record?
        self.position = (quiz.questions.maximum(:position) || 0) + 1
      end
      save!

      options.destroy_all
      non_empty_rows.each_with_index do |row, idx|
        options.create!(
          body: row[:body],
          correct: row[:correct],
          position: idx + 1
        )
      end
    end

    true
  end

  private

  def swap_positions!(other)
    my_pos = position
    other_pos = other.position
    if my_pos == other_pos
      quiz.questions.reorder(:position, :id).each_with_index do |q, i|
        q.update_columns(position: i + 1)
      end
      reload
      other.reload
      my_pos = position
      other_pos = other.position
    end
    update_columns(position: other_pos)
    other.update_columns(position: my_pos)

class QuizImport
  attr_reader :raw_json, :quiz, :errors

  def initialize(raw_json = "")
    @raw_json = raw_json.to_s
    @quiz = nil
    @errors = []
  end

  def save
    @errors.clear
    @quiz = nil

    parsed = parse_json_object
    return false unless parsed

    attrs = validate_and_extract(parsed)
    return false unless attrs

    ActiveRecord::Base.transaction do
      created_quiz = Quiz.create!(title: attrs[:title])

      attrs[:questions].each_with_index do |q_attrs, q_idx|
        question = created_quiz.questions.create!(
          body: q_attrs[:body],
          active: q_attrs[:active],
          position: q_idx + 1
        )

        q_attrs[:options].each_with_index do |opt_attrs, opt_idx|
          question.options.create!(
            body: opt_attrs[:body],
            correct: opt_attrs[:correct],
            position: opt_idx + 1
          )
        end
      end

      @quiz = created_quiz
    end

    true
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => e
    @quiz = nil
    @errors << e.record.errors.full_messages.to_sentence
    false
  end

  private

  def parse_json_object
    if @raw_json.strip.empty?
      @errors << "Quiz JSON can't be blank"
      return nil
    end

    begin
      parsed = JSON.parse(@raw_json)
    rescue JSON::JSONError, EncodingError
      @errors << "Invalid JSON"
      return nil
    end

    unless parsed.is_a?(Hash)
      @errors << "Quiz JSON must be a JSON object"
      return nil
    end

    parsed
  end

  def validate_and_extract(parsed)
    cleaned_title = extract_title(parsed["title"])
    raw_questions = parsed["questions"]

    unless raw_questions.is_a?(Array)
      @errors << "Questions must be an array"
      return nil
    end

    extracted_questions = []
    raw_questions.each_with_index do |raw_q, idx|
      extracted = extract_question(raw_q, idx + 1)
      extracted_questions << extracted if extracted
    end

    return nil if @errors.any?

    {
      title: cleaned_title,
      questions: extracted_questions
    }
  end

  def extract_title(raw_title)
    if raw_title.nil?
      @errors << "Title can't be blank"
      nil
    elsif !raw_title.is_a?(String)
      @errors << "Title must be a string"
      nil
    elsif raw_title.strip.empty?
      @errors << "Title can't be blank"
      nil
    else
      raw_title.strip
    end
  end

  def extract_question(raw_q, q_num)
    unless raw_q.is_a?(Hash)
      @errors << "Question #{q_num} must be an object"
      return nil
    end

    cleaned_body = extract_question_text(raw_q["text"], q_num)
    q_active = extract_question_active(raw_q, q_num)
    extracted_options = extract_options(raw_q["options"], q_num)

    return nil if cleaned_body.nil? || q_active.nil? || extracted_options.nil?

    {
      body: cleaned_body,
      active: q_active,
      options: extracted_options
    }
  end

  def extract_question_text(raw_text, q_num)
    if raw_text.nil?
      @errors << "Question #{q_num}: Question can't be blank"
      nil
    elsif !raw_text.is_a?(String)
      @errors << "Question #{q_num}: Question text must be a string"
      nil
    elsif raw_text.strip.empty?
      @errors << "Question #{q_num}: Question can't be blank"
      nil
    else
      raw_text.strip
    end
  end

  def extract_question_active(raw_q, q_num)
    return true unless raw_q.key?("active")

    value = raw_q["active"]
    if value == true || value == false
      value
    else
      @errors << "Question #{q_num}: active must be true or false"
      nil
    end
  end

  def extract_options(raw_options, q_num)
    unless raw_options.is_a?(Array)
      @errors << "Question #{q_num}: Options must be an array"
      return nil
    end

    extracted_options = []
    options_valid = true

    raw_options.each_with_index do |raw_opt, opt_idx|
      opt_num = opt_idx + 1
      unless raw_opt.is_a?(Hash)
        @errors << "Question #{q_num}, option #{opt_num} must be an object"
        options_valid = false
        next
      end

      opt_text = raw_opt["text"]
      if opt_text.nil?
        @errors << "Question #{q_num}, option #{opt_num}: Option text can't be blank"
        options_valid = false
      elsif !opt_text.is_a?(String)
        @errors << "Question #{q_num}, option #{opt_num}: Option text must be a string"
        options_valid = false
      elsif opt_text.strip.empty?
        @errors << "Question #{q_num}, option #{opt_num}: Option text can't be blank"
        options_valid = false
      end

      opt_correct = false
      if raw_opt.key?("correct")
        if raw_opt["correct"] == true || raw_opt["correct"] == false
          opt_correct = raw_opt["correct"]
        else
          @errors << "Question #{q_num}, option #{opt_num}: correct must be true or false"
          options_valid = false
        end
      end

      if opt_text.is_a?(String) && !opt_text.strip.empty?
        extracted_options << { body: opt_text.strip, correct: opt_correct }
      end
    end

    if raw_options.size < 2
      @errors << "Question #{q_num}: Add at least two options"
      return nil
    end

    return nil unless options_valid

    if extracted_options.none? { |o| o[:correct] }
      @errors << "Question #{q_num}: Mark at least one option as correct"
      return nil
    end

    extracted_options
  end
end

cat <<'EOF' > docs/architecture.md
# Quizzy Architecture & Design Notes

## Overview

Quizzy is a Rails 8.1 application using SQLite (`storage/`), Propshaft, Importmap, Turbo, Stimulus, and Solid Cable / Solid Cache / Solid Queue (all configured to store data exclusively under `storage/` with zero external service calls).

## Boot & Production Serving (`bin/serve`)

- `bin/serve` sets `RAILS_ENV=production` and `PORT` (default `3000`), precompiles assets (`bin/rails assets:precompile`), prepares SQLite databases (`bin/rails db:prepare`), and runs Puma in the foreground bound to `0.0.0.0:$PORT`.
- Plain HTTP is used (`config.assume_ssl = false`, `config.force_ssl = false`) and all hostnames are accepted (`config.hosts.clear`).
- `GET /up` serves the public health check (`200 OK`).
- Every route under `/moderate` inherits from `Moderate::BaseController`, which enforces HTTP Basic Authentication against `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_USERNAME"]` and `ENV["QUIZZY_MODERATOR_PASSWORD"]`.

## Data Model & Quiz Export / Import

- `Quiz` (`quizzes`): `title` (required, whitespace-normalized). Has many `questions` ordered by `(position, id)` and `active_questions` (`where(active: true)`).
  - `Quiz#as_export_json` / `Quiz#to_export_json` exports strictly `{"title", "questions" => [{"text", "active", "options" => [{"text", "correct"}]}]}` in order, with no database IDs, timestamps, or runtime session/game data.
- `QuizImport` (`app/models/quiz_import.rb`): parses and validates quiz JSON (`active` defaults to `true`, `correct` defaults to `false`, enforcing all question form rules) and creates the new `Quiz`, `Question`s, and `Option`s atomically inside a single database transaction.
- `Question` (`questions`): belongs to `quiz`; `body` (required), `active` (boolean, default `true`), `position` (integer). Has many `options` ordered by `(position, id)`.
  - `Question#save_with_option_rows` skips blank option rows, validates at least 2 non-empty options (`"Add at least two options"`) and at least 1 correct non-empty option (`"Mark at least one option as correct"`), and atomically replaces options in a transaction while preserving submitted rows in-memory on validation failure.
  - `move_up!` / `move_down!` swap `position` with the adjacent question in a transaction.
- `Option` (`options`): belongs to `question`; `body` (required), `correct` (boolean, default `false`), `position` (integer).

## Frontend & Design System (`quizzy.css`)

- `app/assets/stylesheets/quizzy.css` and `app/assets/fonts/Inter-latin.woff2` come directly from `docs/mockups/`.
- Note for future releases: `quizzy.css` already includes pre-built styles for upcoming features:
  - **Big-screen presentation**: `.cover`, `.cover--blue`, `.cover--night`, `.screen`, `.screen-controls`, `.lobby`, `.qr`, `.counter-pill`, `.stage-question__*`, `.stage-options`, `.stage-option.is-correct`, `.leaderboard`, `.leader.is-winner`.
  - **Mobile participant play**: `.play`, `.play-options`, `.play-option`, `.play-status--right`, `.play-status--wrong`, `.result-card`, `.winner-banner`, `.join-form`, `.waiting`, `.waiting__gem`.
  - **Moderator responses**: `.tabs`, `.tab`, `.mark`, `.response-options`, `.response-option`, `.runs-table`, `.badge--running`, `.badge--finished`.
- Stimulus controllers:
  - `option-rows` (`app/javascript/controllers/option_rows_controller.js`): dynamically adds/removes and renumbers option rows (`Option N` / `Option N is correct`) on the question form.
  - `active-toggle` (`app/javascript/controllers/active_toggle_controller.js`): immediately persists `Active` checkbox changes via `fetch(..., { keepalive: true })` and updates active counts/numbering in-place.
- Moderator Preview (`Moderate::PreviewsController#show`): stateless `GET`-driven flow through `quiz.active_questions` in order without writing any database or session state.
EOF
